name: text-field
description: A single-line text input with its label, optional description and validation error. Compose the parts you need inside TextField: TextField.Label, TextField.Input, TextField.Description and TextField.Error (renders only while the value is invalid).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every edit.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a value before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents editing and dims the field.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: string) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid value, shown by TextField.Error.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates as the user types.

example:
<TextField name="email" isRequired>
  <TextField.Label>Email</TextField.Label>
  <TextField.Input type="email" />
  <TextField.Description>We never share it.</TextField.Description>
  <TextField.Error />
</TextField>
